notes.title: Resolution Patch
notes.content:
Sorry about the wait, but we have fixed the resolution bugs.

Patch Notes:

1. Game will now default to maximum resolution on the first startup.

2. In VR you can now increase and decrease the resolution with the arrow keys

3. Removed the Level 1 button to reduce confusion about future levels.


--------

For those of you who are stuck at a super low resolution, you can follow the instructions figured out by WWA3463 to get out of "Blind Mode"

-Choose the second option of the first menu.
-Choose the first option of the second menu.
-Use the Up Arrow Key to increase the resolution.


------

Again, thank you all for supporting us over the weekend! 
Hope you all have a nice rest of the week!

notes.title: Steam VR Version of Gravity Compass is Live
notes.content:
After a slight delay from launch, Gravity Compass now supports SteamVR. So all of you who have an HTC Vive can now enjoy Gravity Compass in Virtual Reality.

Again thank you all for the support and I hope to see you lose yourself in Gravity Compass soon!

notes.title: "Flatscreen Mode" enabled. No need for Oculus to play.
notes.content:
Sorry for the hiccup, we are still figuring things out when it comes to Steam. There is now a launch mode for what we here at NovaWake call "Flatscreen Mode" or the ability to play a VR headset.

We have seen several of you ask for a SteamVR version, and I am happy to say that we are currently figuring out a solution. We are currently having compatibility troubles with SteamVR and we may have to wait until Unity intergrates SteamVR natively into the engine. We apologize for the inconvenience.

In the meantime, we recommend using Revive to get it to work on the HTC Vive.

Revive: https://github.com/LibreVR/Revive

Thank you all for showing your support for our first title and we hope to see you losing yourself in Gravity Compass.
